title: Bin-size sweep and 1-ms synchrony (Nashef reconciliation)
question: Is Nashef's 1-ms synchrony rise during reach compatible with fixed J at 10 ms: timescale, operating point, or cell selection?
headline: N1 (pre-registered) not significant: 1-ms SI rise before endpoint in suppressed pairs +0.06, 13/21, p=0.29; positive lean in all blocks (washout p=0.014 uncorrected). N2 kappa and N3 operating-point UNVALIDATED (null test: kappa biased +0.19; N3 FPR 12%). Synthetic: shared gain inflates SI strongly.
